title: Trophies and Echoes
blurb: Hang what you have beaten, and bind what has fallen.

steps.text: Hang a boss trophy on a Trophy Mount.
steps.hint: The first time you beat each Gate Lord it drops its trophy.
Each different boss in it adds 1% damage and half a heart.

steps.text: Bind an Echo from a fallen elite, warden or boss.
steps.hint: Tap B within 6 blocks during the ten seconds it lingers.
Guard, Haul, Farm, Mine or Train: an Echo works the pad while you are away.

steps.text: Put an Echo to work on a pad.
steps.hint: Pads take Echoes that aren't marching, strongest first.
Echoes heal and train faster there.

steps.text: Hold a gate break near home.
steps.hint: Your Guards go to it, and the Hearth shields you while it lasts.

finish.line: Your home has a guard, and a hall of what you have beaten.
